source_user.content: user outer annulus, cluster integral and detail preservation reference, empirical guarantees unverified

fit.queries: all original F source IDs, complete current source topology
fit.points: all vertices in hop interval, no sampling or cropped domain
fit.cache: source adjacency and source/query-ID BFS to10 shared across all observations and overlapping patches
fit.normal: saved observation input normal promotedfloat64 and unit-renormalized; only zero/nonfinite invalid
fit.frame: axis e=argmin(abs(n)) ties xyz, t1=unit(cross(n,e)), t2=cross(n,t1), basis columns[t1,t2,n]
fit.Ri: max current Euclidean length over same full1-10 neighborhood, shared acrossbranches
fit.quadratic: [u²,uv,v²,u,v,1], z WLS exp(-4||q||²) then3 Tukey IRLS c4.685 MAD1.4826 floor1e-4
fit.rank: at least6 points and full6 rank at every np.linalg.lstsq(rcond=None), otherwise output0 with failure denominator
fit.prediction: r=f*Ri, positive along current observation unitnormal
fit.condition: weighted design 2-norm via singular values, nonfinite serializednull with reason
fit.area: sum complete CURRENT source incident triangle area/3 for each vertex

aggregation.ell: old observation median edge scale in native units
aggregation.seed_calibration: 33dev normal all F pooled scores, linear q90 independently solid/ring, strict>
aggregation.components: topology-induced F selected by abs(r)/ell>q90, not split by sign; >=5 points
aggregation.T: abs(sum(A*r))/ell³ = E*C, broadcast constant per retained component, otherwise0
aggregation.operation_points: four own q95 of33development normal perpatch maxima, linear interpolation, strict>
aggregation.freeze_order: CALIBRATION and freeze committed before validation score summaries or labels read for evaluation
aggregation.normal_FPR: same dev calibration target, report actual calibration and validation FPR separately

evaluation.ordinary_y: original damaged mask S on all F
evaluation.strong_y: norm(reference-observed)>0.10ell on all F, weakdamaged count explicit as strong-task negatives
evaluation.ROC: average ranks for score ties, only when both classes, elseNone
evaluation.AP: threshold-grouped average precision sum(delta_recall*precision), no positivesNone, singleton positives with no negative AP defined and flag
evaluation.per_case: all eligible F same denominator including invalid fits withscore0
evaluation.patch_macro: average valid case metrics withinpatch for specified subset, then equal average patches, absentclasscases excluded with count
evaluation.point_pool: all F in subset including normalcontrols, report counts
evaluation.groups: all/development/validation center/offcenter, source/patch/strength, ordinary and strong separately
evaluation.operation_recall_gate: position group pooled selectedS currentarea / S currentarea, case and patchmacro also reported
evaluation.operation_metrics: point/area precision-recall, missed damage area, selected normal area, zero detection cases, false normalpatches, components and failure denominators
evaluation.history: same-F saved old OPT p ranking only, no old model forward or new repair

depth.S_metrics: r vs d RMSE/native and /ell, zero-prediction baseline, bias, sign, amplitude and completevalid/invalid denominators
depth.normal_metrics: legitimate current normal residual tails/p95/max, never use reference normal in fit
depth.baseline_nearzero: ratio N/A when baseline_RMSE<=64*float64eps*ell numerical roundoff, retain absolute/eligible/full denominators
depth.fit_failure: r0 on allF, labels only in evaluation

decision_targets.result: failed fixed construction closes, partial success identifies one concrete gap; no score/ring/degree/seed/threshold search or architecture promise

views.scope: explain saved real geometry only, no added cases

budget.dependencies: existing CPUvenv and PRETRAIN private/deps read-only, no new install
budget.performance: machine exclusivity unverified, no formal speedup claim

cost: shared source/topology/BFS/cache/frames/areas and each branch fit, seed/q95 calibration, cluster, all evaluation, recovery and report wall/CPU/RSS; independent complete cost plus4marginals, shared cache consumption explicit
delivery: fixed commit under current directory, private arrays/plots excluded fromGit, HANDOFF one callback then end for review
